newsitem.title: USA: Crompton & Knowles reduces debt in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Crompton & Knowles reduces debt in Q2.

text.p: Crompton & Knowles Corp said it reduced its debt load by $39 million in the second quarter of 1997.

"Our second quarter performance met our two primary objectives -- to deliver substantial earnings growth and to significantly reduce debt," said Chief Executive Vincent Calarco. "We are pleased with our strong earnings growth and pleased to report a $39 million debt reduction during the second quarter. Year-to-date, debt has been reduced by $68 million," he said.

Net earnings before extraordinary losses on early extinguishment of debt increased 30 percent in the second quarter to a record $31.8 million, or $0.42 per share, compared with $24.4 million, or $0.34 per share, last year.
Net earnings including extraordinary losses on early extinguishment of debt were $30.5 million, or $0.40 per share, compared to $23.9 million, or $0.34 per share, in the second quarter of 1996.
Sales for the quarter ended June 28, 1997, rose five percent to $494.1 million compared to $469.6 million last year.
